## Summary

ZEPHYRIA LOGISTIC NOVA SRL (fictional) scores 61.7 (RED) with 8/8 sources available. High signals appear in financials, tax and network.

## Red signals

- Submitted 2025 figures differ from ANAF: turnover 25,400,000 vs 18,600,000 RON, net result +1,200,000 vs -350,000 RON, employees 14 vs 2. [TAX-DECLARED-GAP-01]
- Administrator Ionel Fictivescu is linked to 4 failed companies (Kestrel, Orvanto, Pelinor, Vantiro). [NET-SERIAL-ADMIN-01]
- Invoices of 2,100,000 RON form a cycle Zephyria -> Mirelda -> Kestrel -> Zephyria. [NET-CIRCULAR-INVOICE-01] (MOCK source)
- 2025 equity was -111,000 RON, below half of the 200 RON share capital. [FIN-NET-ASSETS-01]

## Yellow signals

- Administrator changed on 2025-11-02. Registered office shared by 63 companies. [ID-ADMIN-CHANGE-01, ID-SHARED-OFFICE-01]
- Turnover grew from 410,000 RON (2022) to 18,600,000 RON (2025) with 2 employees. [FIN-REVENUE-JUMP-01, FIN-HEADCOUNT-01]
- No public footprint despite 18,600,000 RON turnover. [PRE-NO-FOOTPRINT-01]
- **Unvalidated:** an article published on 2026-04-12 reports searches at firms run by Ionel Fictivescu. [MED-ADVERSE-01]

## Coverage

All 8 agents completed. MOCK sources used: e-Factura, shareholders, tax arrears list, D300.

questions.question: Please explain the difference between the submitted 2025 turnover (25,400,000 RON) and the ANAF figure (18,600,000 RON).
What goods or services were invoiced to Mirelda Servicii Imaginare SRL, and by Kestrel Fictiv Transport SRL to you, in 2025?
What is Ionel Fictivescu's role in Kestrel, Orvanto, Pelinor and Vantiro, and why did they fail?
How is 18,600,000 RON of transport turnover delivered with 2 employees (subcontractors, fleet)?
What is the plan to bring equity back above half of the share capital?

rejected.text: The company is very likely a missing-trader fraud vehicle.
rejected.reason: opinion / accusation not supported by any signal
